scope: P3-SUPERCELL-20 semantics; no runtime or public-contract change

mesocyclone_semantics.meaning: storm-scale rotation / radar-signature semantics, distinct from a confirmed supercell
mesocyclone_semantics.semantic_decision: current runtime mapping is too broad and must be separated in P3-SUPERCELL-30/-40

consequences: tornado or waterspout can hide simultaneous supercell text from the primary label
supercell can hide downburst, severe_thunderstorm or hail from the primary label
existing additive tornado, hail and wind-hazard dimensions partially preserve multi-hazard evidence but there is no additive supercell dimension yet

explicit_event.meaning: supercell/superzelle is explicitly named in provider event labeling

contextual_text.meaning: supercell/superzelle appears only in contextual provider text

authoritative_references.finding: A supercell is distinguished by a deep and persistent rotating updraft called a mesocyclone.
Mesocyclone is properly a Doppler-radar rotation term and should not be treated as a visually observed phenomenon.
Mesocyclones are frequently associated with supercells, which does not make the terms semantically identical.

invariants: Official supercell alert evidence is not a confirmed supercell observation.
Mesocyclone is not a visual observation.
Thunderstorm cell is not automatically supercell.
Thunderstorm probability is not supercell probability.
Real supercell evidence must not be considered absent solely because another primary hazard label matched first.
Missing alert stage is not invented.
Provider ID is not a scoring axis.
Endpoint reachability is not coverage proof.
Private extensions remain outside the standard core contract.
decisions_for_p3_supercell_30: Keep weather.warning.official as the candidate broad official transport unless design proves a new public ID is necessary.
Represent official_supercell_alert_event additively and independently of primary hazard_type.
Represent explicit_event versus contextual_text supercell evidence.
Reuse alert_stage for official supercell alert semantics.
Remove mesocyclone/mesozyklone from automatic supercell evidence in the design.
Keep mesocyclone rotation signature, confirmed/observed supercell and supercell probability outside the broad official-supercell alert class.
Preserve existing tornado, hail and wind-hazard additive dimensions.
